comment: Shared vectors for the inline-command rule (trust contract v2, R1): Claude Code runs !`cmd` wherever it appears on a line, so a SKILL.md carrying one is executable. ox (internal/teamskills/trust.go) and the SageOx server (packages/teamskills) must both pass every vector; change them together.
